sections.heading: RIIT
sections.body: The four Gamma values are Respect, Integrity, Innovation and Teamwork.
keyPoints: R — Respect: promote mutual respect and understanding.
I — Integrity: do business with a moral compass.
I — Innovation: continuously innovate and improve.
T — Teamwork: play as one to win together.
sections.memoryTip: Say RIIT in order: Respect → Integrity → Innovation → Teamwork.

lessons.title: Respect
lessons.summary: Treat everyone fairly and with dignity.

sections.heading: Core promise
sections.body: Gamma's Respect value is to promote a culture of mutual respect and understanding.
keyPoints: Treat employees, customers and stakeholders with dignity and fairness, regardless of position.
Address colleagues professionally, including by first name.

sections.heading: Behaviours to avoid
sections.body: The source asks employees to avoid conduct that harms mutual respect.
keyPoints: Do not intimidate, victimize or harass.
Avoid gossip, rumours and misleading information.
sections.memoryTip: Think: respect people in words and actions.

sections.heading: Moral compass
sections.body: The Integrity value calls for transparency, honesty and high ethical standards.
keyPoints: Be transparent in monetary and non-monetary transactions.
Keep company data and information confidential.
Do not accept personal gifts from suppliers, service providers or customers.
sections.memoryTip: Integrity = trustworthy actions even when no one is watching.

sections.heading: Best practices
sections.body: The source also asks teams to avoid destructive shortcuts and conflicts of interest.
sections.memoryTip: Never trade trust for a shortcut.

sections.heading: Create and improve
sections.body: Innovation means continually exploring more effective approaches.
keyPoints: Challenge the status quo with calculated risks.
Proactively contribute ideas and participate in projects.

sections.heading: Learning agility
sections.body: The source promotes open-minded problem solving, adaptable decisions and learning from mistakes as a team.
keyPoints: Approach problems with an open mind.
Respond with business, people and learning agility.

lessons.title: Teamwork
lessons.summary: Play as one to win together.

sections.heading: Shared goals
sections.body: Gamma's Teamwork value focuses on collaborating and recognizing contributions.
keyPoints: Take responsibility for mistakes together and learn from them.
Support colleagues' development and seek help when needed.

sections.heading: Trust and ownership
sections.body: The source stresses faith in the team, open discussions and shared ownership of decisions.
keyPoints: Aim for decisions supported across the team.

sections.heading: Meaning and purpose
sections.body: A policy is a collection of principles and guidelines that steers decisions and actions across an organization.
sections.memoryTip: Policies answer: what should we do and why?

sections.heading: Key benefits
sections.body: The source lists risk management, efficiency and accountability as additional reasons for policies.
sections.memoryTip: Consistency • Compliance • Guidance • Risk • Efficiency • Accountability.

sections.heading: Work with RIIT
sections.body: Gamma Way of Working brings the company's four values into everyday work.
sections.memoryTip: Apply RIIT before making a decision.

sections.heading: Ethical Behaviour
sections.body: The Ethical Behaviour Policy is intended to ensure integrity, honesty and fairness and foster a positive, lawful work environment.
sections.memoryTip: Ethics applies even when no one is observing.

sections.heading: Conflict of Interest
sections.body: The Conflict of Interest Policy addresses situations where personal interests interfere with professional duties.
keyPoints: Put the company's interests first when performing duties.
Identify and avoid competing personal interests.
sections.memoryTip: Personal interest must not override your job duties.

sections.heading: Prevention
sections.body: The source describes a policy defining and prohibiting harassment, bullying and discrimination.
keyPoints: Follow established reporting and incident procedures.
sections.memoryTip: Speak up through approved workplace channels.

sections.heading: Speak up
sections.body: The policy encourages reports of serious misconduct and aims to protect employees who make them from retaliation.
keyPoints: Report genuine concerns through approved channels.
Protect the confidentiality of reports as required.
Do not retaliate against people who raise concerns.

sections.heading: IT User Acceptance
sections.body: The IT policy guides proper, secure and responsible use of company technology and information resources.
sections.memoryTip: Think before clicking, sharing or storing.

sections.heading: Social Media
sections.body: The Social Media Policy guides how professional and personal social media activity can affect the company's reputation.
sections.memoryTip: Online conduct reflects on your team.

sections.heading: Staff distribution
sections.body: The document describes a requirement for restaurants to distribute 100% of service charges fairly to staff and maintain records of charges and payments.
keyPoints: Accurate records of charges and payments.
Refer to current company policy for individual entitlements.
sections.memoryTip: 100% refers to the service-charge pool under the policy.
